contract.coordinate_convention: original pixel centers; half-pixel edge centers
contract.label_lookup: floor(xy+0.5); reject out-of-bounds, never clip endpoints
contract.similarity: float64 cosine; normalize after interpolation; exact zero unavailable
contract.sampling: row-major grid round-robin; within cell horizontal then vertical, y then x
contract.reference_filter: initial endpoints target/non-target; neither endpoint void 255
contract.derangement: SHA256 evr0031-pairing-v1 + sequence + index ordering, one-cycle shift
contract.ranking: maximize signed score; exact ties use [0,-r,+r,-2r,+2r] order
contract.fallback: fewer than two usable reference pairs or invalid native descriptors -> native
contract.gt_lookup: same-orientation scanline crossing; absent crossing has capped loss 1
contract.void_policy: current 255 background, counted; initial void endpoints excluded
contract.aggregation: equal queries per event; empty event deltas zero; equal 24 events per parent; equal 4 parents
contract.scientific_scope: TRAIN candidate-ranking information only; no whole-mask or novelty claim
